geometry.coordinates: Original cell anchor-relative native XYZ and BSC3 source frames; use original fixture/context frame, not ENU area priors.
geometry.planes: Outward unit Float64 n.xyz and d, solid n dot p <= d; offsets delimit each prism.
geometry.binding: prism_binding columns are original parent source ordinal, own analytic part ordinal. Native original Part/Face IDs remain unknown.
geometry.fallback: prism_fallback_faces are original whole-view triangle indices; fallback_* preserve their complete original geometry/attributes.
geometry.bvh: node_children: inner child pair, or [-1, primitive ordinal]; node_bounds are conservative. Omitted primitive bounds can be recovered from leaves.
geometry.source_ids: Parent ordinals are stable within the original parent; do not deduplicate anonymous external IDs.

material.codes: Material dictionary pairs selected by own source-relative gable test, material_code_index maps planes to dictionary. Categories never interpolate through packed U.
material.normal: Baseline analytic plane normal for analytic hits, unpacked original Oct16x2 vertex normals for fallback; not raster-identical.
material.wall_rows: material_edge_offsets per primitive; rows correspond to wall planes starting at prism_offsets[primitive]+1.
material.fields: Source frames/heights/edge/bays/metres plus explicit codes reconstruct continuous local UV/metres; ready consumer requires no BSC3/GEOS.
material.fallback_colour: Empty fallback_colour means shared white RGBA; nonwhite original factors otherwise retained.
material.reference_shader: Original flat facadeCode is separated before interpolation; UV/bay/metres/RGBA interpolate. Neutral diagnostic PBR does not implement native procedural filtering/emissive/opacity/TAA/MSAA/caster/reflections.

exact_control.positions: Float32 native position bit patterns as uint32 dictionary, position_indices retain triangle order.
exact_control.attributes: Float32 bit dictionary of post-vertex UV.xy and metres.xy; white RGBA implicit for this input. attribute_indices retain corners.
exact_control.normal_code: normal_code_index selects normal_table packed Oct16x2 and explicit code_table category per triangle.
exact_control.source_runs: source_ids with source_offsets retain original triangle-order source membership. No required native part/face tags are invented.

limits: Existing unchanged baseline, not the new plane-fit correction.
Known moving-023 material/normal switch and static-025 coverage loss remain failures.
One complete original native cell; not all 3054 Shell cells, world, device/p99 or native material/transition admission.
Asset/reference input only; no images, new export format, source acquisition or scene rebuilding.
